description: The outcome of importing MJML markup. Document is null only when a fatal error prevented producing a model; warnings describe lossy or unsupported parts.

members.name: Document
members.description: Gets the imported document, or null on fatal error.

members.name: Errors
members.description: Gets the fatal errors that prevented (or degraded) the import.

members.name: Warnings
members.description: Gets the non-fatal findings (lossy fallbacks, unsupported features).
